RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

Follow up on your request for written feedback first. Directly alleging sex discrimination without documentation can damage your professional standing, particularly as the appointee possesses relevant project leadership credentials.

However, an all-male panel raises valid concerns regarding unconscious affinity bias. Whether to raise it depends on two factors:

1. **Civil service policy:** Many public administrations mandate gender-balanced interview panels. If formal guidelines were breached, you can challenge the process on procedural compliance grounds without making personal accusations.
2. **Written feedback:** Once received, check whether the scoring rubric was applied objectively against your qualifications and interview performance.

Frame any formal inquiry around procedural compliance and scoring consistency rather than a direct accusation of bias.
